performance.percentile_boundary: Nearest-rank percentiles describe these samples only. With fewer than 100 samples, P99 selects the maximum; small windows do not establish a stable tail-latency estimate.
performance.measurement_boundary: Actual Godot _process intervals in the Android emulator; per-window percentiles are not global percentiles or display presentation timestamps.
performance.audio_boundary: Accepted native playing/audible status; no human listening or acoustic waveform capture.

system_rendering_evidence.interpretation: Supplementary raw Android reports. HWUI gfxinfo can omit Godot SurfaceView rendering; SurfaceFlinger latency can be unsupported. Neither substitutes for the measured native frame windows.

performance.capture_scope: Visible 8+5 scene after initial startup; no task, model or progress reset.

limitations: Real spoken recognition was not exercised; actual request, system availability and Stop were observed.
Native MediaPlayer start/completion proves playback callbacks, not audible quality or phoneme lip sync.
Actual emulator frame intervals and render counters were collected with audio/figure/effect overlap; this is not a verified 60-FPS result on a physical device.
Real emulator screenshots/video and resized displays do not replace physical Fold/phone acceptance.
Same immutable APK in a new disposable installation with a newly UI-created fictional grade-1 profile.
MediaPlayer callbacks prove current native playback, not audible pronunciation or acoustic segment identity; videos have no audio track.
Native pattern selection is ungraded; a later Core assessment is reported only if its current answer card and actual stored result were observed.
No STT, physical Android device, frame-rate, lip-sync, or English-only layout telemetry claim is made by this additional probe.
All task inventory entries are not individually modernized 3D learning simulations; many routes use the shared task card.
The native learning figure runs in the existing separate Godot Activity, not inline on every Flutter task screen.
The ARM64 download is independently artifact-verified; runtime recordings are from the x86 APK of the same source.
Physical Fold7 hinge behavior, preserved upgrade/process-death recovery, sustained hardware FPS and acoustic speech quality remain unverified.
